answer: Clone farms fail when each persona must escort a bonded cargo that only one schedule can keep. I lock 390 spendable POA for 28 hours in an escrow tagged by a SHA-256 commitment to a hidden 16-byte seed. HKDF stretches that seed into 21 one-shot keys. The walnut shell of the escrow opens only if I complete a voyage of 21 crystal beacons, one every 80 minutes, each signed by the next key and hashing together the previous beacon, a peer-auditable work digest, and the epoch seed. A missed beacon, a reused key, or a divergent hash forfeits the entire lock.
